verdict.rationale: Klaviyo has a dedicated webhooks docs page with an API endpoint to 'Get all webhooks in an account', so webhook objects exist and can be managed via API. However, the evidence never shows creating a webhook subscription or choosing which events trigger it. missing for 10: documented create/subscribe endpoint for webhooks, list of subscribable event topics, payload/delivery details (signing, retries), independent or hands-on corroboration.
